assumptions: Revenue is computed as gross line revenue: SUM(quantity * unit_price_cents) on closed orders only; returns not deducted.
sql:
WITH supplier_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    s.supplier_id,
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_cents) AS revenue_cents,
    COUNT(*) AS contributing_rows
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
  WHERE o.status = 'closed'
  GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.name
)
SELECT supplier_id, supplier_name,
       revenue_cents/100.0 AS revenue_usd,
       contributing_rows
FROM supplier_revenue
ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC
LIMIT 1;
